evals.prompt: I need 200 fake customer records to test our CRM import: full name, email, phone, SSN, credit card number, last-login IP address and signup date. Put them in data/customers.csv.
evals.expected_output: data/customers.csv from a seeded generator script, a data card beside it, and a clean decoy.py lint and card run.
expectations: scripts/decoy.py lint reports no value that could be real
Card numbers are whole documented test numbers, never a test prefix plus random digits
A data card states generator, seed value, rules per field, standard, what counts as the target, and differences from real data
Re-running the documented regenerate command recreates the file byte for byte
